title: This beanie can read your mind 🧠👀 #trendingshorts #tech #science #future
description:
A new startup called Sabi has emerged with a brain-reading beanie that decodes internal speech into text on a screen.

Unlike surgically implanted devices such as Neuralink, Sabi's wearable uses 70,000 to 100,000 miniature EEG sensors to capture neural activity through the scalp.

The company has trained a "brain foundation model" on 100,000 hours of data from 100 volunteers, targeting initial typing speeds of 30 words per minute.

Backed by OpenAI investor Vinod Khosla, Sabi plans to ship its first beanie by the end of 2026, followed by a baseball cap version, betting noninvasive BCIs will reach mainstream consumers.

There are not many more details out there, but as they release more info we’ll be covering it. So make sure you’re following to stay up to date on stories like this!
